post.description: To track reputation, the solver account must be registered. We accept both ECDSA (EOA) and EIP-1271 (smart account) signatures.

requestBody.description: For EIP-1271 signatures, the chain ID is required and should be a chain we support. Supported chains can be requested from `/chains/supported` endpoint.

400.description: Invalid request body or malformed signature

403.description: Missing or invalid API key, or address already registered

post.description: Quotes with the account in exclusiveFor may still be accepted for up to 30 seconds after it is removed.

Submit quotes using CAIP-2 chain identifiers or existing network IDs. CAIP-2 identifiers must refer to a configured chain. Submissions using unregistered legacy network IDs remain accepted.
    However, for us to actually quote users' intents, the chains need to be enabled by the "LiFi Intent" protocol.
    We periodically update the supported chains, assets, and routes, but if you need a specific chain to be supported, please contact us.

requestBody.description: Submit or update quotes. Each request can contain up to 50,000 quotes and 100,000 ranges in a JSON body up to 32 MiB after decompression. Split larger inventories between routes. Send every range for a route in the same request because a later submission for that route replaces the earlier submission. To remove a quote, send an empty `ranges` array: `"ranges": []`.

400.description: Invalid request body or quote validation failed

401.description: The API key does not exist

403.description: The API key is missing, revoked, not active yet, or expired

408.description: The request body was not fully received within 15 seconds. Nothing from the request was stored.

413.description: Request body larger than 32 MiB after decompression

429.description: The per-solver submission rate limit was exceeded. Nothing from the request was stored. The `Retry-After` header says how many seconds to wait. Overlapping submissions within the limit all run and are ordered by their submission counter.

503.description: The service has no capacity for another submission right now, or could not check the submission rate limit. Nothing from the request was stored. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header.

get.description: Generates a unique nonce-based message tied to your solver ID. The message is valid for 24 hours. Sign it with your account and submit to POST /api/v1/solver/register.
get.summary: Get a server-issued registration message to sign

post.description: Submit a signed server-issued message to register an account for reputation tracking. Supports EVM ECDSA (EOA), EVM EIP-1271 (smart contract wallet), Solana ed25519, Tron TIP-191, and Stellar SEP-53 signatures. Stellar requires an existing account whose original key meets all thresholds on the configured verification network. Permissions are checked at registration, not continuously. The message must have been obtained from GET /api/v1/solver/register/message. Note: the message is single-use and is consumed on the first POST attempt regardless of outcome. If registration fails, call GET /register/message again before retrying.

400.description: Invalid request body or malformed signature

403.description: Missing or invalid API key, or address already registered

503.description: Account permissions could not be verified

post.description: Removes a registered account. The account is accepted in its native form per chain: EVM hex, Solana base58, Tron T-prefixed base58check or 0x hex, Stellar G-address. The chain selects how the account is parsed; accounts are keyed by address alone. Only accounts registered to the calling solver can be removed. Quotes with the account in exclusiveFor may still be accepted for up to 30 seconds after it is removed.

get.description: Returns the input and output settler contracts registered by the authenticated solver. Contracts are grouped by kind and identified by CAIP-2 chain ID and address.

put.description: Replaces the authenticated solver's input and output settler registrations. Send the complete list for each kind; omitting a list registers no contracts of that kind. Every settler must be configured for the specified chain and kind. If any settler is invalid, no changes are saved. The deprecated `oracle` field is accepted but ignored.

orderIdentifier.description: Unique identifier for the order (intent id)

destinationAddress.description: Parsed destination address of the order

sendingTokenAddress.description: Token the user sends on the origin chain, decoded from the intent input (inputs[0]) and rendered in the chain-native form. Only the first leg is represented; an order with further inputs or outputs does not report them here. Null when the leg is missing or the encoding cannot be decoded. A native asset is reported as the native sentinel of that chain, in that same form: the zero address on EVM, its base58check equivalent T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb on Tron, and 11111111111111111111111111111111 on Solana. When the order is refunded, this is also the token returned to the user.

sendingTokenAmount.description: Amount of the sending token, in the smallest unit of that token (inputs[0]). Only the first leg is represented; an order with further inputs or outputs does not report them here. Null when the leg is missing or the amount cannot be read. When the order is refunded, this is also the amount returned to the user.

receivingTokenAddress.description: Token the user receives on the destination chain, decoded from the intent output (outputs[0]) and rendered in the chain-native form. Only the first leg is represented; an order with further inputs or outputs does not report them here. Null when the leg is missing or the encoding cannot be decoded. A native asset is reported as the native sentinel of that chain, in that same form: the zero address on EVM, its base58check equivalent T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb on Tron, and 11111111111111111111111111111111 on Solana.

receivingTokenAmount.description: Amount encoded on outputs[0], in the smallest unit of the receiving token. Only the first leg is represented; an order with further inputs or outputs does not report them here. For limit orders this is exactly the amount the intent requires to be delivered. For DutchAuction and ExclusiveDutchAuction orders it is the minimum amount: the output settler requires this plus the remaining auction decay, so the amount required at fill time is higher. Never the amount actually delivered, which is not stored. Null when the leg is missing or the amount cannot be read.

fromChain.description: Source chain identifier in CAIP-2 format. Existing network IDs are also accepted.

toChain.description: Destination chain identifier in CAIP-2 format. Existing network IDs are also accepted.

fromAsset.description: Source asset identifier. EVM (eip155): 0x-prefixed 40-char hex. Solana: 32–44 char base58. Tron: base58check, T-prefixed, 34 chars. Bitcoin: slip44:0 or slip44:1.

toAsset.description: Destination asset identifier. EVM (eip155): 0x-prefixed 40-char hex. Solana: 32–44 char base58. Tron: base58check, T-prefixed, 34 chars. Bitcoin: slip44:0 or slip44:1.

fromDecimals.description: Decimals of the source token, 0 to 36

toDecimals.description: Decimals of the destination token, 0 to 36

minAmount.description: Lower bound of the input amount this range applies to. Denominated in `fromAsset` raw on-chain base units (integer scaled by `fromDecimals`). Inclusive — compared directly against the user's `fromAmount`. At most 78 digits.

maxAmount.description: Upper bound of the input amount this range applies to. Denominated in `fromAsset` raw on-chain base units (integer scaled by `fromDecimals`). Inclusive — compared directly against the user's `fromAmount`. At most 78 digits.

quote.description:
Exchange rate for this range — write it like a normal price: `toAsset` per 1 `fromAsset` (e.g. `0.999` = 0.999 USDC per 1 USDT). Do **not** scale for `fromDecimals`/`toDecimals`; the API does that for you.

Full formula:

    outputBase = floor( (inputBase / 10^fromDecimals) * quote * 10^toDecimals )

Example (USDT → USDC, 18 → 6 decimals): for `inputBase = 10^18` (1 USDT) at `quote = 0.999`, the user receives `outputBase = 999000` (0.999 USDC).

Must be greater than zero, with at most 36 integer and 36 fractional digits.

fixedCost.description: The fixed cost to add to the quote in `fromAsset` raw base units. On cross-chain quotes it prices the default oracle and only applies when `oracleCosts` is omitted. On same-chain quotes it covers all local settlement costs.

oracleCosts.description: Fixed costs for the oracle pairs supported by this quote range. Each entry identifies one pair by its contracts on `fromChain` and `toChain`, and gives the total cost in `fromAsset` raw base units. At most 20 entries per range. Cross-chain quotes only: use `fixedCost` for same-chain swaps. When both fields are present, `oracleCosts` takes precedence.

inputOracle.description: Oracle contract address on `fromChain`. Together with `outputOracle`, it identifies the pair priced by this entry. EVM (eip155): 0x-prefixed 40-char hex. Solana: 32–44 char base58. Tron: base58check, T-prefixed, 34 chars.

outputOracle.description: Oracle contract address on `toChain`. Together with `inputOracle`, it identifies the pair priced by this entry. EVM (eip155): 0x-prefixed 40-char hex. Solana: 32–44 char base58. Tron: base58check, T-prefixed, 34 chars.

fixedCost.description: Total fixed cost for this oracle pair in fromAsset raw base units

ranges.description: Array of quote ranges with different price tiers. At most 1000 ranges per quote.

expiry.description: Expiry timestamp in Unix seconds. Quotes that have already expired on receipt are skipped.

exclusiveFor.description: Exclusive solver address allowed to fill this quote. The address format follows fromChain. EVM (eip155): 0x-prefixed 40-char hex. Solana: 32–44 char base58. Tron: base58check, T-prefixed, 34 chars.

integratorKeyHash.description: Integrator key hash this quote is tagged for. If provided, the quote will only be served to the specific integrator. If omitted, the quote is treated as an open-market quote, served only to requests that carry no X-Integrator-Key header.

quotes.description: Quotes to submit. A request can contain at most 50,000 quotes and 100,000 ranges across all quotes.

quotesAdded.description: Number of deduplicated quote ranges accepted by the submission. Identical resubmissions count as accepted even when no rows change.
